site.name: Arushi
site.title: Arushi — Product Designer
site.tagline: Product designer who cares about outcomes, not just outputs.
site.intro: Currently a lead product designer at Adobe. Over 8+ years I've worn many hats, from retail banker to risk analyst to product designer. I love figuring out what people need, building it, and making it better over time.

private.title: Adobe
private.summary: Designing intuitive B2B experiences: improving workflows, shipping new features and building scalable design frameworks.

experience.desc: Sole designer on Sales Qualifier, an AI-powered B2B sales assistant: 30+ features in 4 months across SDR workflows, AI reply management and onboarding. Cut the backlog 40%, lifted onboarding bookings 35% and won the Gen AI Hackathon 2026.
Designed a 0-to-1 customer acquisition platform across 15+ sprint releases, built a scalable design system and tested with 200+ users to lift engagement 40%.
Owned interaction design across 225+ digital touchpoints, ran 30+ A/B tests and drove £400K pipeline growth. Mentored content designers and junior analysts.
Cut credit decisioning time 22% through API-led platform requirements and built SQL and Power BI dashboards that raised stakeholder adoption 14%.
Cut delivery cycle time 30% with rapid iteration and experimentation, and lifted digital adoption 14% by optimising journeys and onboarding content.
Grew an INR 250 crore portfolio from 8,000 to 25,000 accounts and led the 0-to-1 launch of PNB One, reaching 4,000+ users in Q1.

projects.title: Tactile Brush
projects.summary: A haptic feedback system that bridges the tactile gap between digital and traditional painting.
projects.intro: Can gesture-based and haptic interactions make digital creation more intuitive, expressive and physically sustainable? Tactile Brush explores a multisensory interface for realistic digital painting.

meta.Tools: Figma, Adobe Fresco, Sensel Morph / Apple Pencil

projects.title: CreativeFlow AI
projects.summary: An AI-powered assistant that takes creators from script to final cut.
projects.intro: A concept platform helping creators, marketers and businesses produce video faster, with intelligent writing assistance, automated B-roll suggestions and mood-based music matching.
projects.challenge: Creators spend around 60% of their time on non-creative tasks like finding stock footage and music. How might AI reduce friction in the creative workflow?
projects.insight: Users don't want AI to replace their creativity. They want it to handle the tedious parts so they can focus on telling their story.

projects.title: Netflix Games Discovery
projects.summary: How might we lift game discovery and first-time player conversion by 15% in six months?
projects.intro: A product strategy case study on creating a seamless bridge between Netflix's content and its gaming experience.

projects.title: Catalyst Bank
projects.summary: A brand identity and landing page for a UK business bank that acts as a growth partner.
projects.intro: Catalyst Bank helps entrepreneurs and small business owners. The goal was a clean, elegant identity and landing page that speaks to people looking to elevate their business.
projects.vision: To make banking easier for small businesses by being their growth partner, their catalyst to success.
projects.mission: To become a leader in business banking for entrepreneurs by delivering reliable financial support and connectivity to technology.

projects.title: Mau Jewels
projects.summary: A lotus-inspired identity for dainty, artisanal jewellery.
projects.intro: A brand identity for customers who love expressing themselves through jewellery, inspiring confidence and celebrating womanhood from product to visual identity.

projects.title: Sticks & Wicks
projects.summary: A quirky, minimal brand for homegrown soy candles inspired by seasonal fruit.
projects.intro: A fun but premium identity for environmentally conscious, aesthetic customers. The hand-drawn '&' joins the S and W and echoes the fumes of a candle wick.

meta.Tools: Adobe Illustrator, Nano Banana Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Canva

life.title: Beyond the portfolio
life.intro: When the laptop closes, I'm usually lost in a book, scribbling a poem, or making a mess with paint. Slow, human things that keep the rest of my work honest.

facts.label: Always reading
facts.text: A book is usually within arm's reach. Stories are where most of my ideas start.

facts.label: Poetry on the side
facts.text: I write poems to make sense of things I can't fit into a design brief.

facts.label: Paint & pencil
facts.text: Painting and sketching keep my hands busy and my eye sharp.

facts.label: AI tinkering
facts.text: I experiment with AI for fun too: weird prompts, small tools, happy accidents.
